title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Idea for Zoo?
God dammit it autoplays on my phone and I just watched that
Good morning, Greg!!!
That’s a bad one, too
In the 90th percentile

Well I’ll see if I can recreate at the zoo sometime soon. I’ll start by flirting with the zookeeper, seducing one and finally convincing them to let me see the animals even closer. We’ll begin a relationship, talk and build trust, while I get closer to the codes and access. We’ll date, maybe get married, however long it takes. Then one day when she’s sleeping in, I’ll leave the divorce papers on the bed, steal her access card, let the zebra into the crocodile pit and run away.
Lol
Hahaha... and we’ll set up a camera for all of the clicks on Freep.com
Of course. I see now flaw in this plan.
I feel like me and you have talked about how Verlander probably wanted to knock Kate Upton up
So now he has a tangible bond in case they ever break up
Lol we might have but that’s OK because it’s very accurate. You know he’s hedging his bets before the impending divorce
Absolutely
The fuck did you go to the hospital for?
I had some bacterial infection
Been dealing with it for almost a month
Jesus. That’s a terrible time for it bug you
I know
I thought it was just from drinking way too much
That’s why I didn’t drink in CLE
That’s how long it’s been lol
Good lord that’s awful. What a memorable road trip though haha
I’ll spare you the details but Thursday morning I was like F this I’m going to the hospital
You still going to the All Star Game or will you have to go home?
I’m still going I need to see my girlfriend lol
Figured that was the case haha
Marlins twitter really toeing the line
